headline: South Africa Targets R4.4 Billion Annual Savings Through Early Retirements
summary: The South African government expects its voluntary early-retirement programme to deliver annual savings of R4.4 billion while creating capacity for frontline posts.
why: Public sector wage bill management is a critical fiscal metric monitored by bondholders and international ratings agencies assessing South Africa's debt sustainability.

impacts.name: South African Government Bonds
impacts.why: Lower fiscal expenditure can improve sovereign credit metrics, though short-term exit costs apply.
